name: matwerkta
description: An organisational work unit is modelled as an objective specification (obo:IAO_0000005) that is decomposed into work-package textual entities with obo:BFO_0000051 and is the subject of the processes carrying it out via nfdi:NFDI_0000226. The unit is thus represented by what it specifies rather than as an opaque organisational node.
competency_questions: Which task areas comprise NFDI-MatWerk, and what responsibilities does each hold?; Which researchers and organizations participate in a specified task area?; What infrastructure use cases and participant projects does a task area encompass?
